meta.title: Fix Claude animation flickering with vt10x-inspired terminal state deduplication
meta.body_summary: Claude Code's PR to reduce terminal animation flickering by introducing vt10x-inspired deduplication, dirty tracking, and debouncing of WebSocket updates, claiming a 72% reduction in updates.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code PR with vt10x deduplication; coderabbit found multiple correctness and formatting issues; CI failed; maintainer closed with emphatic 'burned it with fire'.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1585 changed lines across 12 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor by absolute volume. It targets terminal flickering through multiple backend changes. Despite the scale, the PR was closed without merge due to CI failures and a strong maintainer rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbit flagged missing dirty line tracking in clear operations, incorrect callback unregistration, package-level variables, missing mutex for concurrent access, Go formatting errors, invalid CSS selectors, and error handling gaps. CI failures in Node.js and Swift tests also indicated integration problems.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces WebSocket updates by 72% and eliminates Claude animation flickering via vt10x-style deduplication and debouncing.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer steipete closed the PR with the comment 'burned it with fire' after CI failures and multiple correctness issues flagged by coderabbit, indicating strong rejection and no intent to proceed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Claude_Code attempted a multi-file Go refactor with terminal buffer logic, but the implementation had correctness issues (missing dirty tracking, concurrency concerns), formatting errors, and CI failures. The agent struggled to produce a quality, passing change in this complex domain.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbit provided detailed code review with multiple correctness and style issues; maintainer steipete responded with a dismissive rejection rather than a detailed review.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI failed for Node.js and Swift tests, indicating integration issues that the maintainer likely saw as blocking.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR provides a narrative claim and an unverified table but no profiler output, before/after logs, or test results to substantiate the 72% reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer closed the PR after CI failures and code quality issues with no fix-in-pr cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Implemented vt10x-inspired terminal state deduplication with dirty line tracking, change flags, sequence-based snapshot deduplication, and 50ms debouncing across Go backend files. Added raw WebSocket endpoint for direct PTY streaming, enhanced terminal buffer with incremental updates, and added a dark-themed CSS file. Intended to reduce WebSocket update frequency by 72% during Claude thinking animations.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Additional files include eventloop timeout reduction, terminal flag changes, new raw WebSocket endpoint, SSE debouncing, and a full CSS dark theme for the web UI.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: implemented terminal state deduplication and raw WebSocket streaming across 11 files.
Second commit: added debouncing and deduplication to /stream SSE endpoint in sse.go.
CI failed; coderabbit flagged multiple issues; maintainer closed without further changes.

review_signals.summary: UnregisterDirectOutputCallback incorrectly clears all callbacks instead of the specified one; suggested unique ID or clearing all.
rawPTYCallbacks and rawCallbackMutex are package-level; should be instance fields to avoid conflicts.
Go files not formatted; run gofmt.
Invalid CSS wildcard selectors 'terminal-*' in view-transition rules.
Clear operations in buffer.go don't mark lines as changed, causing incremental updates to miss changes.
SSEStreamer fields accessed from multiple goroutines without synchronization.
Timer callback error handling only logs without signaling main loop.
Closed PR with comment 'burned it with fire', indicating complete rejection.
CI failed for Node.js and Swift tests.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial commit implementing deduplication and raw WebSocket handler.
coderabbit posted in-depth review with multiple correctness and style issues.
Second coderabbit review on new file.
Maintainer steipete closed PR with dismissive comment.
